description: A 3-D volume (reconstruction, simulation, segmentation) as a stack of slices along its k axis. Voxel (i, j, k) = (column, row, slice) has its centre at voxel_to_world * (i, j, k, 1), indices at voxel centres. The slices series holds one sample per slice in k order; its time is when the volume was made.

voxel_to_world.description: 4x4 row-major affine from voxel index (i, j, k, 1) to world (x, y, z, 1).

voxel_size.description: Edge along i, j, k (the column norms of voxel_to_world).

quantity.description: What the values are: attenuation, gray_value, label, ...

acquisition.description: Node path of the acquisition it was made from.

parameters.description: Settings it was made with, e.g. the reco.json (JSON).

reconstruction.description: Node path of the reconstructions/<run> that made it.
